# Forestry

> Forestry is a UAE-based custom planter and pot manufacturer serving interior designers,
> landscape architects, architects, and commercial contractors.
> All products are manufactured to client specifications. No minimum order quantity.

## Company

Forestry manufactures custom planters and decorative pots for commercial and residential
projects across the UAE and GCC. Products are made to order — any size, any colour
(RAL/Pantone matched), any texture, any finish. Manufacturing tolerances of ±1mm are
maintained across production runs from 1 to 10,000+ units.

Based in the UAE. B2B trade supplier only.

## Products

Categories:
- Cylindrical planters (indoor and outdoor)
- Rectangular planters (single trough and multi-trough formats)
- Square planters
- Conical planters
- Custom bespoke architectural forms

Materials:
- GRC (glass-reinforced concrete): preferred for large outdoor and public realm installations
- Fiberglass / GRP: preferred for interior commercial and hospitality applications
- Polystone: selected for decorative and detail-rich forms

Finishes: matte, gloss, textured, stone-effect, brushed, metallic.
Colour matching: Pantone and RAL references accepted on all orders.
Sizes: any dimension manufactured to specification. No standard size catalogue.

## Who We Serve

- Interior designers and design firms (UAE and GCC)
- Landscape architects and landscaping contractors
- Property developers (residential, hospitality, mixed-use)
- Facilities management companies
- Hotel groups and resort developers
- Mall operators and retail developers
- Government and municipal projects
- FF&E procurement teams

## Process

1. Apply: Submit trade licence for vendor account approval (24–48 hours)
2. Configure: Set dimensions, colour, texture and finish via online portal
3. Submit RFP: Attach technical drawings, quantities and delivery requirements
4. Quote: Receive a formal line-itemised quotation within 48 business hours of RFP receipt

## Key Facts

- 500+ approved trade vendors in network
- 48-hour quote turnaround on all complete RFPs
- No minimum order quantity — single prototype to 10,000+ unit production runs
- ±1mm manufacturing dimensional tolerance
- UAE-based production
- AED pricing; GCC and international supply available

## FAQ

Q: What materials are used for custom planters?
A: GRC (glass-reinforced concrete) for large outdoor installations; fiberglass/GRP for
interior and hospitality; polystone for decorative forms.

Q: What is GRC?
A: Glass-reinforced concrete — a lightweight composite of cement and glass fibres that
provides the aesthetic of concrete with greater structural strength. UV-stable and suited
to UAE outdoor climate.

Q: What is the minimum order quantity?
A: None. Forestry manufactures from a single prototype to 10,000+ unit production runs
on the same standards and terms.

Q: How long does a quote take?
A: 48 business hours from receipt of a complete RFP with specifications, quantities,
and delivery requirements.

Q: Can planters be colour matched?
A: Yes. Pantone and RAL references accepted on all orders across all materials.
